description: Firearm and ammunition profiles plus parsed grenade, melee, and tactical clothing entries from the supplied reference documents. Unsupported conditional and timed rules are retained in descriptions or properties for manual adjudication. AC formulas on vests and armored rigs assume the character base AC is 10; backpack carrying capacities remain descriptive. Armor locations, gear weights, container capacities, storage slots, ricochet chances, and faction disposition are structured for character-sheet calculations.

items.name: F-1 / M67 / RGD-5 Grenade
items.description: After 3 turns, all targets within the blast radius make a DC 18 DEX save. On a failed save, they take the listed piercing damage. App fields do not resolve the delay or save outcome; adjudicate those from this description.

items.name: VOG-17 / VOG-25 Grenade
items.description: After 2 turns, targets within the blast radius make a DC 20 DEX save at disadvantage. On a failed save, they take the listed piercing damage. App fields do not resolve the delay, disadvantage, or save outcome; adjudicate those from this description.

items.name: Impact Grenade
items.description: Targets in the 10 ft area immediately make a DC 22 DEX save at disadvantage. Failed save: 60d60 piercing damage; successful save: half damage. App fields do not resolve disadvantage or success/failure damage; adjudicate those from this description.

items.name: Flashbang
items.description: Targets in the 20 ft area make a DC 18 CON save or are blinded until the next round, at the start of their next turn. App fields do not resolve the condition or duration; adjudicate those from this description.

items.name: 9 Banger
items.description: Targets in the 40 ft area make a DC 24 CON save at disadvantage or are blinded for 1 minute. App fields do not resolve disadvantage, the condition, or duration; adjudicate those from this description.

items.name: Model 8230 CS Gas
items.description: Creates a 20 ft area lasting 5 rounds. Targets without full-face gas masks immediately make a DC 22 CON save or suffer asphyxiation and are stunned until they leave the area or the gas disperses. Targets that succeed repeat the save at the start of each turn they remain in the gas. Regardless of save, unmasked targets take 1d6 gas damage when entering the area and at the start of each turn they remain in it. The app does not resolve masks, repeating saves, conditions, or damage-over-time; adjudicate those from this description.
